test_IsKeyword: test the IsKeyword function to check if a C++ token is a keyword
test_IsBuiltinType: test the IsBuiltinType function to determine if a C++ token is a builtin type
build_keyword_set: build a set of all C++ keywords by combining TYPES, TYPE_MODIFIERS, CASTS, and other keyword categories
review_ALL_keywords: review the ALL set containing all C++ keywords including types, casts, control flow, and exceptions
summarize_keyword_categories: summarize the C++ keyword categories: TYPES, TYPE_MODIFIERS, ACCESS, CASTS, CONTROL, EXCEPTION, and LOOP
